en.bdb: The apostate himself is a culprit

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਰੜੁ ਮੋਠੁ ਨ ਰਿਝਈ ਕਰਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੋਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: koraR moTh na rijhiee kar aganee josu|

en.bdb: When moth, an Indian pulse is cooked over the fire some grains being hard remain uncooked.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਫਲਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਿਗੜੈ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਦੋਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: sahas falahu ik vigaRai taravar kee dhosu|

en.bdb: This is not the fault of the fire. If one fruit out of a thousand go bad, it is not the fault of the tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਟਿਬੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ ਘਣਿ ਵਰਸਿ ਗਇਓਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: Tibai neer naa Thaaharai ghan varas giosu|

en.bdb: It is not the fault of water that it will not rest on a hill.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਮਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਵੈਦ ਨ ਰੋਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: vin sa(n)jam rogee marai chit vaidh na rosu|

en.bdb: If a sick person die from not observing the regimen prescribed for him, it is not the fault of the doctor.
If a barren woman have no offspring, it is her destiny and not the fault of her husband.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਪੜ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਇਲਮ ਜਿਉ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਓਸੁ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh paRhai na ilam jiau avagun sabh os ||8||

en.bdb: In the same way if a perverse man accept not the Guru's instruction, it is his own fault and not the Guru's.
